editorial:
Imagine traveling to a remote island where people can literally wipe their memories and start their lives over from scratch. That is the wild setup you get here. You follow Nicola, a photographer who falls head over heels for Laure, a free spirit who loves to push boundaries. Along with an anthropologist and his partner, they head into the jungle to find the Mara tribe during their special festival of rebirth. The whole vibe is very dreamy and adventurous, making you feel like you are on a strange journey where the rules of normal society just do not apply anymore.

What really stands out is the bold way the movie handles romance and freedom. While the pacing is a bit slow at times, the scenery and the chemistry between the leads keep you interested. It is not a high-action flick, but it makes you think about whether you would actually want to forget your past to be happy. If you can find a high-quality 4K Blu-ray for your collection, it is the best way to see the lush colors. Otherwise, keep an eye out for it to stream in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video for a crisp experience.
endingExplained: As the group reaches the Mara tribe, the tension peaks during the rebirth ceremony. Laure decides to fully embrace the tribe's way of life. She chooses to leave her old identity and her relationship with Nicola behind to start fresh. Nicola is left heartbroken and confused, realizing that her desire for total freedom was stronger than her love for him. The movie ends with her becoming part of the island, leaving the others to return home changed.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves old school art films and stories about escaping society.
